name: Official package da'wah and general Islamic content source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Use only an approved, verified repository and preserve source framing and attribution.
notes: Registry metadata only. A concrete source, URL, license, and verification record must be selected before ingestion.

name: Approved Qur'an text and translation source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Use an approved and verified text source; preserve the distinction between original text and translation.
notes: No Qur'anic text or translation is included or claimed as ingested.

name: Approved tafsir source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §3 and §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Keep tafsir distinguishable from Qur'anic text and preserve its attribution and framing.
notes: Tafsir is deferred until source quality and corpus controls are confirmed.

name: Authenticated hadith source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Attribute hadith only when source and accepted grading metadata are supported by the corpus.
notes: No hadith text, grading, or source record is included or claimed as ingested.

name: Approved aqeedah and introductory source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Preserve source framing and avoid presenting disputed matters as unsupported certainty.
notes: Concrete source selection and verification remain future work.

name: Recognized fiqh reference source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Do not transform general fiqh material into an autonomous personalized fatwa or automatic tarjih.
notes: No fiqh content or ruling is included or claimed as ingested.

name: Controlled seerah and history source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §3 and §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Add only if time permits and source quality remains controlled.
notes: No historical content is included or claimed as ingested.

name: Approved doubts and frequent-questions source family
usageRule: Preserve source framing and do not convert a reference response into unsupported certainty.
notes: A concrete approved repository and rights record must be documented before ingestion.

name: Approved Islamic terminology and translation source family
reference: BUILD_BIBLE.md §10; organizer scientific package source-policy category
usageRule: Prefer approved terminology references over naive literal machine translation for sensitive terms.
notes: No terminology entries or translations are included or claimed as ingested.
